name: RelaxedRS07
title: RS07 indel model with lognormal branch-rate variation

citation.title: Incorporating indel information into phylogeny estimation for rapidly emerging pathogens.

args.name: rate
args.description: The common insertion-deletion rate scale, relative to substitutions

args.name: sigma
args.description: The standard deviation of log branch-rate multipliers

args.name: meanLength
args.description: The mean indel length in alignment symbols; must be at least 1

args.name: topology
args.description: The tree topology, normally supplied automatically

description:
Allows the insertion-deletion rate to vary among branches. Each branch receives an independent multiplier whose logarithm has mean zero and standard deviation sigma. The multipliers have median 1; rate sets the common rate scale. Indel lengths are geometrically distributed with a shared mean, measured in alignment symbols. Insertions and deletions are symmetric.

Branch rates also include any multipliers supplied through `--indel-rates`. The default `--indel-rates` already introduces lognormal branch variation; use `--indel-rates=constant` to use only the variation supplied by this model.
